description: handoff: hand over mail that lands mid-turn (stop), wake an idle agent when its mail lands (idle), and retire that idle waiter when a new turn starts (busy). Silent for sessions that never ran `handoff join`.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/handoff"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$f" hook stop
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/handoff"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$f" hook idle
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/handoff"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$f" hook busy
